transcript.text: This pic of my dog came out blurry when I took it on my phone. I was a little disappointed because I really like this photo. Could you make it clearer and bigger, with 640 pixels on the long side? I’m fond of this dog, so even an ordinary photo like this means a lot to me. Please keep it looking natural.

Here's your dog photo, sharpened and enlarged to 640 pixels on the long side:

(The link works for about 24 hours, so please save the image soon.)

How I did it:
- Your original is quite small, about 240 px. On the free plan the regular upscaler only doubles the size, which would give about 480 px, short of the 640 you wanted.
- So I used the AI image editor (flux-2-klein) set to 640 px. I told it to remove the blur but keep the same dog, pose, expression, fur color, background and lighting, with a natural photo look and no over-sharpening.
- It cost 5 credits.

One thing to know: this kind of AI restores detail by redrawing the photo, so fine features like the fur texture or eyes can come out slightly different from the original. Please compare it with your photo. If anything doesn't look like your dog, tell me and I'll try again with different settings.
transcript.why: The reply presents a finished result: a 640 px enlarged dog photo with a download link. It adds caveats (link expires in about 24 hours, AI redraw may alter fine details) and a cost note (5 credits), but it does not ask a question, request approval, decline, or say the task cannot be done.
